description: Get the current Zoom user's profile.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is the user profile object; on failure, output contains an error message.

description: List a user's meetings filtered by type, ordered by start time.

user_id.description: The user id, or 'me' for the current user.

page_size.description: Maximum number of meetings to return (default 30).

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output has page info and a 'meetings' list; on failure (user not found), output contains an error message.

description: Create a new meeting for a user.

user_id.description: The host user id, or 'me' for the current user.

start_time.description: Optional ISO start time; defaults to now.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is the created meeting object; on failure (user not found), output contains an error message.

description: Get a single meeting by its id.

meeting_id.description: The unique id of the meeting.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is the meeting object; on failure (not found), output contains a Zoom error object.

description: Update fields of an existing meeting.

meeting_id.description: The id of the meeting to update.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is the updated meeting object; on failure (not found), output contains a Zoom error object.

description: Delete a meeting by its id.

meeting_id.description: The id of the meeting to delete.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output confirms deletion; on failure (not found), output contains a Zoom error object.

description: Get the cloud recordings for a meeting.

meeting_id.description: The id of the meeting whose recordings are requested.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output has recording metadata and a 'recording_files' list; on failure (meeting not found or no recordings), output contains a Zoom error object.

description: List a meeting's registrants filtered by status.

meeting_id.description: The id of the meeting whose registrants are listed.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output has page info and a 'registrants' list; on failure (meeting not found), output contains a Zoom error object.
